protocol.description: Predeclared random open-1D Clifford+T brickwork. Initial H,T; each round random H/SX/SXdg then T/Tdg on every site, alternating CZ matching; final H. No seed selection.

queries.parity: expectation of Z on every site

protocol.timing: Fresh isolated single-thread process per row; execution excludes imports and circuit/backend construction; cold observer tables included. Peak RSS includes setup. MPS bond logging enabled. One run, no statistical speedup claim.
